startNow.title: It's Not Too Late to Start Now.
startNow.subtitle: Early intervention makes the critical difference between miniaturized and restored follicles.
startNow.content: Hair thinning is a progressive biological process. DHT (Dihydrotestosterone) gradually binds to vulnerable receptors, shrinking follicles and shortening growth cycles. However, as long as hair follicles remain alive, targeted topical stimulation can help restore blood flow, nutrients, and cellular regeneration.
bulletPoints: Follicles remain viable years before irreversible dormancy occurs.
Topical Minoxidil dilates micro-capillaries to supply oxygen and vital amino acids.
Derma rolling enhances topical absorption up to 3x while stimulating collagen synthesis.

hairThinning.title: Understanding Hair Thinning
hairThinning.subtitle: Why hair loses density and how early detection saves thinning crowns & temples.
hairThinning.intro: Pattern thinning is not an overnight event; it develops silently across months. Here is what happens beneath the scalp surface:

stages.title: Healthy Hair Follicles
stages.description: Follicles are deeply rooted in the dermal layer. Blood vessels supply ample oxygen and nutrients, keeping 85-90% of hairs in the active growing (Anagen) phase.

stages.title: Miniaturization Begins
stages.description: DHT sensitivity constricts micro-vessels. Hair shafts become progressively finer, shorter, and brittle as the growth phase shortens drastically.

stages.title: Visible Scalp Exposure
stages.description: Without topical stimulation, hairs shed faster than they can regenerate, leading to widened part lines, receding temples, and thinning crowns.

howMinoxidilWorks.title: How Does Minoxidil Work?
howMinoxidilWorks.subtitle: The dermatological science behind follicular reactivation and prolonged Anagen growth.

mechanismPoints.title: Potassium Channel Opening
mechanismPoints.description: Minoxidil acts as a potassium channel opener, widening cell membranes and encouraging cellular hyperpolarization.

mechanismPoints.title: Micro-Vascular Vasodilation
mechanismPoints.description: Expands constricted scalp capillaries, boosting immediate oxygen and nutrient delivery directly to dormant follicle roots.

mechanismPoints.title: Prolonging the Anagen Phase
mechanismPoints.description: Transitions prematurely resting (Telogen) follicles back into vigorous, prolonged active growth (Anagen) cycles.

mechanismPoints.title: Thicker Shaft Diameter
mechanismPoints.description: Over consistent application, renewed follicles produce visibly thicker, darker terminal hairs with greater root anchorage.

howMinoxidilWorks.scienceNote: Topical Minoxidil 5% is recommended worldwide by dermatologists as the first-line non-surgical treatment for both vertex and crown hair thinning.
howMinoxidilWorks.anatomyDescription: Topical application widens dormant scalp capillaries, delivering oxygen directly to hair dermal papilla roots.

progressTimeline.title: Every Journey Takes Time
progressTimeline.subtitle: What to realistically expect with consistent daily application. Results vary by individual.
progressTimeline.disclaimer: Important: Consistent twice-daily application is essential. Individual biological response, timeline, and degree of recovery naturally vary.

stages.title: Adjustment & Shedding Phase
stages.description: Old, miniaturized resting telogen hairs shed to make room for healthier new follicles. This shedding is normal and a sign of active response.

stages.title: Early Vellus Hair Emergence
stages.description: Fine, soft baby hairs begin sprouting in previously thinning areas. Follicle roots gain deeper anchorage and improved micro-circulation.

stages.title: Terminal Hair Thickening
stages.description: Vellus hairs mature into pigmented, thicker terminal shafts. Noticeable reduction in scalp visibility and visible density restoration.

stages.title: Optimal Density & Maintenance
stages.description: Full cosmetic density achieved in responsive areas. Continued maintenance routine preserves healthy hair cycles permanently.

usageGuide.title: How to Use Minoxidil
usageGuide.subtitle: Simple 5-step daily routine for maximum absorption and safety.
usageGuide.safetyNotice: For external scalp use only. Do not exceed 1ml per application. Wash hands thoroughly with soap after use. If scalp irritation or dizziness occurs, discontinue and consult a healthcare professional.

steps.title: Cleanse & Dry Scalp
steps.description: Wash your scalp with a gentle shampoo. Ensure hair and scalp are 100% dry before application, as moisture impedes optimal absorption.

steps.title: Measure Exactly 1 mL
steps.description: Draw 1 mL of Minoxidil 5% solution into the calibrated dropper. Never exceed 1 mL per application, regardless of the area size.

steps.title: Part Hair & Apply to Scalp(not Hair)
steps.description: Part hair in areas of thinning (vertex, crown, temples). Gently release drops directly onto the scalp surface, not on hair strands.

steps.title: Wait 3-4 Hours before washing off
steps.description: Lightly spread the liquid over the target scalp area with your fingertips. Do not vigorously rub. Wash hands immediately.

steps.title: Apply twice a day, daily. Consistency is key!!
steps.description: Let the solution naturally absorb for at least 4 hours before washing hair, wearing tight hats, or going to sleep.
